ios.desc:
Discover places, collect memories, and share amazing locations with friends!

Locolle is the ultimate location collection app designed for travelers, foodies, and urban explorers. Whether you're documenting unforgettable travel experiences or curating your favorite restaurant list, Locolle makes it easy to create, organize, and share your personal place collections.

KEY FEATURES

Smart Collection Management
- Create themed collections (e.g., "Tokyo Food Map", "Weekend Camping Spots")
- Add photos, descriptions, and details to each location

Real-time Collaboration
- Invite friends to edit collections together
- Multi-user real-time collaboration with instant sync
- Flexible permission controls to protect your content

Secure Sharing
- Generate share links with one tap
- Optional password protection for privacy
- Copy restriction controls to prevent unauthorized saving

Earth View
- Visualize all your collections on a global map
- Standard, satellite imagery, and hybrid map modes
- Discover where your footprints span across the world

Cloud Sync
- Secure cloud storage for all your data
- Seamless sync across multiple devices

PDF Export
- Export collections as beautiful PDF documents
- Perfect for offline viewing and print sharing

PERFECT FOR

- Travel enthusiasts documenting destinations
- Foodies collecting restaurant discoveries
- Outdoor adventurers marking trails and campsites
- Tour guides sharing professional recommendations
- Friends and families planning trips together

Terms of Use: https://locolle.app/document/tos
Privacy Policy: https://locolle.app/document/privacy-policy

show_hn.title: Show HN: Locolle – A bookmark manager for real-world locations

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m the developer behind Locolle (https://locolle.app). I built it because I was frustrated with how difficult it is to actually "manage" place recommendations.

The Problem: My restaurant/travel saves were scattered across Apple Maps pins, long-forgotten Notes app lists, and buried group chat messages. Google/Apple Maps are great for navigation, but their "saved places" features feel like an afterthought—cluttered and hard to share meaningfully.

The Solution: Locolle treats locations like Spotify treats songs. You can:

- Create themed collections (e.g., "Best Espresso in Tokyo" or "Quiet Bars for Deep Conversations").
- Collaborate on collections with friends/partners in real-time.
- View everything on a 3D Earth view (my personal favorite feature for visualizing travel history).

Technical/Product Choices:

- iOS First: Built with SwiftUI and MapKit. I focused heavily on making the "save" flow as frictionless as possible.
- 3D Visualization: I spent a lot of time tweaking the 3D Earth view to ensure it handles hundreds of pins without performance lag.
- No Gamification: There are no "points," no "fog of war," and no social feed. It’s a tool, not a social network.

Why I’m showing it here: I’m looking for feedback on the UX and the utility. Is this a problem you face? How do you currently manage your "mental map" of the world?

The app is currently on the App Store (iOS only): https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6755667314

I’d love to hear your thoughts, …
